2.14.6 Rectangle.DataElementName
The Rectangle.DataElementName element specifies the name to use for the data element or the
data attribute of a Rectangle, depending on the setting of Report.DataElementStyle. This element is
optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that
is a CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15]. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as the
Name attribute of the rectangle.
Following is the parent element of the Rectangle.DataElementName element.
Parent elements
Rectangle
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Rectangle.DataElementName element.
 <xsd:element name="DataElementName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
